Lao'Jin Master Yaol

observations.label: Offering dialogue and attribution
observations.text:
Lao'Jin Master Yaol
"Master Tallon sent you here to be tested and you shall be. But as I am a bit indisposed at the moment, my pupil, Master Kaol, will need to further you along."

"I sent Kaol, along with the first wave of students, into Tanvu. One of them returned to inform me that the Kojuko gremlins have destroyed one of the outlying magical barriers and currently occupy the route to the city."

"On your way to Kaol, clear the Kojuko from the path so that I may send more students safely through. Good luck."

Master Kaol
"Speak carefully, the emperor's ears are poised and his blade ready."

"Master Yaol has asked me to take over your training, but it seems you have little left to learn."

findings.observation: Primary objective prints two each of Kojuko Beholders, Maneaters and Slayers; photographed-in-game variant prints Safety of the road to Tanvu (0/10). These are separate accounts, not a combined objective.
Description says return to Lao'Jin Master Yaol, while Notes, Hand in to and finishing dialogue identify Master Kaol. Nine attributed disagreements retained in full; no turn-in identity resolved.
Previous links Ra'Jin Assault reciprocally. Next links The Final Tests Of Jin. Navigation does not establish enforced prerequisites.

Coin reward 70 has no denomination. Rewards section retained as HTML including None and displayed item tooltips; display alone does not establish reward choice semantics. Archive screenshot and gameplay-video attributions were not independently verified.
